P: Serve the mains when the tribes gather at the waterfall for the challenge.
S: Beef suya skewers with onion and tomato
the busy street market in Birnin Zana

Thin beef rump strips coated in a peanut, ginger and chilli spice, grilled smoky on skewers and served with sliced tomato, red onion and lime. Blitz 80g roasted peanuts to a fine powder and mix with 2 tsp ground ginger, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cayenne, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder and 1 tsp salt. Slice 800g beef rump into thin strips, toss in oil and then in most of the spice. Thread onto soaked skewers and grill over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side. Scatter with the rest of the spice and serve with sliced tomato, red onion and lime.
Double-fried crispy wings in a sticky gochujang, honey and soy glaze
Korean fried chicken: wings in potato starch fried twice, tossed in gochujang, honey, soy and garlic glaze, sesame on top.
Roast beet, garlic, lemon and dill in thick yogurt, with warm flatbread
Beetroot and yoghurt dip with garlic, lemon and dill, a deep purple, with warm flatbread.
M: Oven-baked spicy tomato rice topped with grilled chicken thighs
Long grain rice cooked in a sauce of blitzed tomato, capsicum, onion and scotch bonnet fried until deep red, with thyme and stock, baked covered at 170C for 40 minutes. Grilled chicken thighs on top.
M'Baku's sweet potato and peanut stew
the mountain chief of the Jabari, up in the snow

Sweet potato, chickpeas and spinach simmered in a rich peanut, tomato and ginger sauce with chilli, over rice with roasted peanuts and coriander. Soften 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger in oil. Add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander and 1 chopped red chilli. Stir in 1 tin crushed tomatoes, 120g smooth peanut butter and 600ml vegetable stock. Add 800g diced sweet potato and 1 drained tin chickpeas and simmer 25 minutes. Stir in 120g spinach and lime juice. Serve over rice with roasted peanuts and coriander.
W: Caramelized ripe plantain with honey, chili flakes and coconut ice cream
Ripe plantains sliced on the diagonal, fried in butter until caramelised, drizzled with honey and a pinch of chilli, coconut ice cream.
K: Hibiscus and ginger tea with pineapple and lime, over ice with sparkling water

Dried hibiscus steeped with ginger, pineapple and lime, chilled deep purple and topped with sparkling water, a nip of white rum for the grown-ups. Bring 1 litre water to the boil with 30g dried hibiscus flowers, a thumb of sliced ginger and 100g caster sugar, then turn off and steep 20 minutes. Strain and chill. Stir in 200ml pineapple juice and the juice of 2 limes. Pour over ice, top with sparkling water and add a lime wheel. Add 30ml white rum per glass for the adults if you like.

s.note: Double-fried crispy wings in a sticky gochujang, honey and soy glaze
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings in 100g potato starch and fry at 160C for 8 minutes, rest, then at 190C until crisp. Simmer 2 tbsp gochujang, 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy and garlic until glossy. Toss and top with sesame.

s.note: Roast beet, garlic, lemon and dill in thick yogurt, with warm flatbread
s.how: Roast 2 beetroots until tender, peel and grate. Mix with 300g Greek yoghurt, a crushed garlic clove, lemon juice and dill. Serve deep purple with warm flatbreads.

m.note: Oven-baked spicy tomato rice topped with grilled chicken thighs
m.how: Blitz a tin of tomatoes, a red capsicum, an onion and half a scotch bonnet, then fry in oil until deep red. Stir in 400g rice, 700ml stock and thyme, cover and bake at 170C for 40 minutes. Grill 800g chicken thighs and lay on top.

w.note: Caramelized ripe plantain with honey, chili flakes and coconut ice cream
w.how: Slice 3 ripe plantains on the diagonal and fry in 40g butter until caramelised. Drizzle with honey and a pinch of chilli flakes. Serve with scoops of coconut ice cream.

d.note: Hibiscus and ginger tea with pineapple and lime, over ice with sparkling water
d.how: Bring 1 litre water to the boil with 30g dried hibiscus flowers, a thumb of sliced ginger and 100g caster sugar, then turn off and steep 20 minutes. Strain and chill. Stir in 200ml pineapple juice and the juice of 2 limes. Pour over ice, top with sparkling water and add a lime wheel. Add 30ml white rum per glass for the adults if you like.
